about_the_game:
Shuttle Mining: Demo Version

This is a demo of Shuttle Mining, a chaotic mining-action game inspired by Noita and Terraria.

What’s in this demo?

This demo includes:

  • The first biome of the game

  • A small selection of laser modules to try out custom laser builds

  • Basic crafting and upgrades

  • A few types of enemies and resources

  • Around 30–60 minutes of core gameplay, depending on playstyle

  • Simulation Mode with a small set of pre-built lasers (no customization in the simulation mode)

Note: Many features are not yet included in this version, such as:

  • Additional biomes

  • Advanced laser effects (explosive, fire, chaining, etc.)

  • Complete module and enemy variety

About Shuttle Mining

Shuttle Mining is a mining game inspired by Noita and Terraria.
Build your own unique lasers, make gigantic beams that destroy everything, and explore a fully destructible underground world full of danger, upgrades, and wild laser experiments.

It blends sandbox creativity with chaotic action in a cozy pixel art universe.

Features:

  • Simulation: Try out crazy lasers before the tutorial — experiment and blow stuff up! (Note: In this demo, the Simulation Mode includes a limited set of pre-built lasers. You can try them once, but you can’t customize them — they use modules only available in the full game.)

  • ⛏️ Mine for Resources:
    Powerful lasers consume lots of energy. Mine ores and minerals to upgrade your character, improve your battery, and craft new items!

  • 🔧 Build Your Own Lasers:
    In Shuttle Mining, you create your own weapons by combining modules. Some make your projectiles bigger and others make them faster. In the full game you make them explosive or set things on fire. The combinations are nearly endless!

  • ⚔️ Defeat Enemies:
    To discover new modules, you’ll need to fight enemies and collect the right recipes and materials to craft them.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5‑7500 or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 630 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 oder 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5‑12400 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 730 or NVIDIA GT 1030 (GDDR5)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
